## History

Jonas [Blake](../character/blake.md) was a theological student who spent a long time attempting to pursue a different path because he initially did not want to become a minister. During a summer at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), he stayed at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse, where he met [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). Though she initially found him funny and ugly, Jonas delivered a deeply moving sermon that earned her profound admiration and left her contemplating whether she was falling in love with him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Jonas P18](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0018), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023), [v3 ch.Christine P2](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0002), [v3 ch.Christine P3](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0003), +8 more_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) initially found Jonas, a theological student, to be funny and ugly when they met at a summer boardinghouse at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). Her perspective shifted entirely after hearing him deliver a deeply moving sermon, leading her to realize her admiration for him and recognize that she was falling in love. The two went on to become close companions who enjoyed fishing, boating, and walking together, ultimately becoming engaged with plans to marry in June.

- Friend of — good chums who fished, boated, and walked together  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
